\begin{dpjourney}
\dpstep{1}{Introduction to Arrays}{Single-pass aggregates $\cdot$ Read/write pointers: compacting in place $\cdot$ Reversal and rotation $\cdot$ Simulation and index arithmetic $\cdot$ Frequency arrays over small values}{Beginner -- 1300}{yes}
\dpstep{2}{Prefix Sums \& Difference Arrays}{Range sum queries $\cdot$ Prefix sums with a hash map $\cdot$ Difference arrays $\cdot$ Two-dimensional prefix sums $\cdot$ Prefix and suffix of other operations $\cdot$ Split points: cutting the array into parts}{CF 900 -- 1700}{no}
\dpstep{3}{Hashing \& Counting}{Complement lookups $\cdot$ Grouping by a transformed key $\cdot$ Distinct values and nearby duplicates $\cdot$ Majority voting $\cdot$ Set membership and remainders}{CF 900 -- 1700}{no}
\dpstep{4}{Two Pointers}{Opposite ends on a sorted array $\cdot$ Fix one, two pointers on the rest $\cdot$ Merging and set operations on sorted arrays $\cdot$ Greedy pairing $\cdot$ Counting pairs with two pointers $\cdot$ Runs of equal or consecutive elements}{CF 1000 -- 1700}{no}
\dpstep{5}{Sliding Window}{Fixed-size windows $\cdot$ Longest valid window $\cdot$ Shortest valid window $\cdot$ Counting windows $\cdot$ Windows with a frequency table}{CF 1100 -- 1800}{no}
\dpstep{6}{Sorting as a Tool}{Sort, then scan neighbours $\cdot$ Custom comparators $\cdot$ Counting and bucket sort $\cdot$ Ranks and sorting by derived keys $\cdot$ The median and exchange arguments}{CF 1000 -- 1800}{no}

\dppartgoals{
  \item reason about arrays as contiguous memory: indices, half-open ranges, in-place updates and the cost model;
  \item answer range questions with prefix sums and apply range updates with difference arrays, in 1D and 2D;
  \item count pairs and subarrays with hash maps, and replace nested loops by two pointers or a sliding window;
  \item use sorting as a preprocessing step, and binary search sorted data with bounds and prefix sums.
}
